response.sql: WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_usage AS avg_bandwidth_usage, s.avg_usage - o.overall_avg AS margin_over_overall FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.avg_usage > o.overall_avg ORDER BY margin_over_overall DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the average of bandusagepct across all telescope rows (not the average of the per-station averages), with NULLs ignored.
The margin is the station average minus the overall average, unrounded.
